instrumentation: Appends a read-only reference to existing sessions module objects; no API/function behavior replacement. Inputs use fill/Tab, checkbox, mouse, or trusted browser touch contacts.

definitions.name: Light

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: White wire is the analog output sampled through host ADC; yellow wire is the comparator digital output. The threshold is mechanically adjustable. Official driver exposes ADC raw/voltage-derived resistance and digital level, not a calibrated lux reading.
gaps: Exact analog rail/maximum and comparator polarity/threshold transfer are not established by the verified product text; do not invent lux calibration.

claims: guest driver transaction path and encoding
reference for implementation; linked document content is not claimed to have been independently reviewed

definitions.blocker: The official contract is documented, but no external Unit controller model, board routing and device-local runtime evidence is validated by this research artifact. Open protocol/electrical questions: Exact analog rail/maximum and comparator polarity/threshold transfer are not established by the verified product text; do not invent lux calibration.
definitions.input_semantics: External world/fixture state, to be delivered through a controller-level device model; not direct guest API return values.
definitions.output_semantics: Observed guest-to-Unit output; read-only to clients.
limitations: All default values are synthetic UI/test fixtures, not measured hardware defaults.
This catalog alone does not authorize a simulated or functional-PASS claim.
